Giant's Bed


PokemonItemsMax Raid Battles


Wild Area?: Yes
North Exit: Frostpoint Field
North Exit: Snowslide Slope
South Exit: Old Cemetery
South Exit: Ballimere Lake
East Exit: Giant's Foot
Access To: Rock Peak Ruins, Iron Ruins

The Giant's Bed is the largest area of the Galar Region and features a variety of different areas including the Rock Peak Ruins and Iron Ruins. It has several lakes and ruins within

Available Weather
Normal Weather, Overcast, Raining, Thunderstorm, Snowing, Snowstorm, Intense Sun, Fog

This area is only available for players who purchased the Pokémon Sword & Shield Expansion Pass
